hypothesis: A separate opt-in durable job ledger can prevent helper step and quote-reservation budgets from resetting across process/tool-instance restarts, while retaining unknown-completion reservations without replay.
existing_gap: HelperRetrieval0.1.2 budgets are per instance. A future wrapper that constructs a new instance per request would reset them.
scope: Local POSIX research coordinator only; no production route, server, plugin, remote inference cancellation or multi-user authorization.
rules: Operator-frozen registry identity, job ID, maximum steps, conservative quote allowance and absolute UTC deadline.
One exclusive append-only reservation per request; an interrupted reservation permanently consumes its allowance for this job.
Completed duplicates return references without quoted source and without dispatching the helper again.
Different payload under the same request ID refuses.
Nonblocking process lock, pinned root and strict bounded file schema; tamper or incomplete records fail closed.
Completion audit failure or unknown helper outcome must suppress newly retrieved quotations.
A late result may be retained but must not be injected after the job deadline.
No claim of durable global model-token accounting: this ledger bounds helper calls and quote bytes only.
cases: No source mutation and no ordinary routing changes
acceptance: No helper dispatch beyond the frozen global allowances, no duplicate/unknown replay, no quote exposure without a completed audit record.
split: Synthetic development regression controls, not independent holdout.
